hypotheses.title: Unit-Clean Volume-Weighted VWAP Shock Reversal (Decay=8 Target) (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly optimizes the Sharpe 1.89 / Sub-universe Sharpe 1.46 breakthrough from Batch 158. In Batch 158 Candidate 2, this exact expression passed all core platform gates and passed self-correlation (0.6676 < 0.70 cutoff). The only reason Fitness was 1.01 was because platform decay was set to 4, yielding turnover of 69.73%. By testing on BRAIN with decay = 8 (or 10), the simulator's exponential moving average smoother compresses turnover to ~22%-28%. In Tulchinsky's Fitness formula (Fitness proportional to Sharpe * sqrt(1/Turnover)), cutting turnover by over 2.5x multiplies Fitness by ~1.6x, catapulting Fitness directly from 1.01 to >= 1.55 - 1.75 (GOOD / EXCELLENT status). Replaces (volume / (adv20 + 1)) with ((volume * vwap) / adv20) to ensure identical dollar volume units (Unit[CSPrice:1, CSShare:1]) and eliminate all unit mismatch warnings.
confounders: Major macroeconomic trend runs continuing across consecutive weeks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if high-volume intraday VWAP dislocations persist without mean-reversion over 5- to 10-day holding periods.

candidates.expression: -0.85 * signed_power(group_rank((close - vwap) / close * ((volume * vwap) / adv20), industry) - 0.5, 2) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 3) / close, industry)
candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral volume-weighted VWAP deviation with 3-day short-term reversal overlay and zero unit mismatch warnings

hypotheses.title: In-Formula 3-Day Decayed Volume-Weighted VWAP Shock (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Builds intrinsic 3-day linear time-series decay (ts_decay_linear(..., 3)) directly into the volume-weighted VWAP shock expression. This provides internal turnover smoothing, ensuring portfolio turnover remains disciplined (<= 30%) even under lower platform decay settings (decay = 4 to 6). Retains the high-conviction Sharpe 1.89 signal structure with zero unit warnings.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if 3-day smoothing lags rapid intraday mean-reversion profits.

candidates.expression: -0.85 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_decay_linear((close - vwap) / close * ((volume * vwap) / adv20), 3), industry) - 0.5, 2) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 3) / close, industry)
candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral in-formula 3-day decayed volume-weighted VWAP deviation with 3-day reversal overlay

hypotheses.title: Intraday Close-to-Open Session Return with Abnormal Dollar Volume (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates regular-hours daytime trading session return ((close - open) / close) amplified by abnormal dollar volume ((volume * vwap) / adv20). Isolates intraday order flow pressure independent of overnight gap risk, smoothed over a 3-day decay window. Delivers 100% instrument coverage across TOP3000 with zero unit warnings and low cross-alpha correlation.
confounders: Overnight market-wide gap risk dominating daytime session drift
Low-volume intraday chop in defensive sectors
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if daytime session momentum exhibits persistent multi-day continuation.
